s: Din choleh beshabbat ubo n"h seipim: mi sheyyesh lo michush bealma sheen bo chashash sakkana kelal, vehu mitchazzeq veholek kebari — asur laasot lo shum repua beshabbat, apillu al yede nokri, ella al derek sheyyitbaer. Vaapillu dabar sheen bo mishshum serak melaka apillu middibre soperim, veen bo shum issur kelal lebari, mikkol maqom kevan sheoseh lirpua venikkar haddabar shemmitkavven lirpua — asur, mishshum gezera shemma yishchoq samemanim lirpua kesheyyihyeh muttar laasoq birpuot beshabbat, veyitchayyeb mishshum tochen:

Mi sheyyesh lo choli shel sakkana — mitzva lechallel alayv et hashshabbat, vehazzariz — hare zeh meshubbach. Vehashshoel — hare zeh shopek damim, vehannishal — hare zeh megunneh, shehaya lo lidrosh barabbim shemmuttar. Vaapillu sepeq nepashot docheh et hashshabbat, shenneemar "asher yaaseh haadam vachay bahem", mah talmud lomar "vachay bahem"? Kelomar, reeh sheyyehe chay vadday baasiyyat hammitzvot, velo sheyyabo al yede kak lide sepeq sakkana. Umikkol maqom, apillu bevadday sakkana — en mechallelin ella birpua shehi yedua lakkol, o al pi mumcheh. Ukeshehi repua yedua, ap sheen yadua im zeh yitrappe bah im lav — mechallelin missapeq:

Kol makka shel chalal, dehaynu beebarim happenimiyyim mehashshinnayim velipnim, veshinnayim atzman biklal — mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat. Vehu shennitqalqelu hashshinnayim o echad mishshear ebarim happenimiyyim mechamat makka, o sheyyesh bahem bua vekayyotze bazeh. Abal michushim bealma enan niqraim makka, veen mechallelin alehem apillu im koeb lo meod. Veim mitztaer kol kak ad shechala mimmennu kol gupo — azay muttar lechallel al yede nokri apillu bimlaka gemura (veim eno mitztaer kol kak — muttar laasot al yede nokri kol dabar haasur mishshum shebut), kemo sheyyitbaer. Velaken mi shechoshesh beshinno umitztaer kol kak ad shechala mimmennu kol gupo (azay muttar lechallel al yede nokri) — omer lenokri lehotzio. Veap shehayyisrael mamtzi lo shinno umesayyea qetzat behotzaato — en bekak kelum, shemmesayyea en bo mammash, lepi sheap im lo haya hayyisrael mesayyeo siyyua zeh, ella shello haya meakkeb al yado — haya hannokri yakol laasot dabar zeh bilbaddo. (Ulehaomerim melaka sheenah tzerika legupah enah asura ella middibre soperim — muttar lehotzio al yede nokri ap im lo chala mimmennu kol gupo, kemo sheyyitbaer):

Makka shel chalal enah tzerika omed, ella apillu bistam sheen sham beqiin shemmakkirin bah shetztzarik chillul, vegam hacholeh eno omer kelum — osin lo kol mah shergilin laasot lo bechol mimmaakalim urepuot shehem yapim lacholeh, ap al pi sheen sakkana kelal bimniat haddabar hahu, kevan shemmikkol maqom hacholi yesh bo sakkana. Abal kesheyyodeim umakkirim beoto choli shehu mamtin veen tzarik chillul — asur lechallel alayv ap al pi shehi makka shel chalal, vekol shekken im hacholeh o habbaqi omer sheen tzarik. Veyesh omerim sheapillu bemaqom shetztzarik chillul — en mechallelin al yede yisrael ella bedabar sheyyesh lachush bo sheim lo yaasehu lo yistakken, abal kol sheen bimniat oto dabar sakkana, ap al pi shemmikkol maqom tzarik hu lo uregilin laasoto lo bechol — en osin oto beshabbat ella al yede nokrim, kedin tzorke choleh sheen bo sakkana. (Veken yesh linhog bimdinot ellu, shennohagim lehachamir apillu bedabar sheyyesh sakkana bimniato shello laasoto al yede yisrael kol sheepshar laasoto al yede nokri belo dichuy veikkub kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer, im ken bedabar sheen bimniato shum sakkana kelal — yesh laasoto al yede nokri, ap im yesh lachush sheyyitatztzel qetzat. Abal im en sham nokri kelal — yesh lismok al sebara harishona. Umikkol maqom, kol baal nepesh yachush leatzmo beissur shel tora):

Makka sheenah shel chalal — nishalin bebaqi ubecholeh, im yomar echad mehem shetztzarik lechillul, o sheyyomar sheim lo yechallelu epshar sheyyakbid alayv cholyo, vehu beinyan sheyyesh lachush sheim yakbid alayv cholyo epshar shemmistakken — mechallelin, veim lav — en mechallelin:

Makka sheal gab hayyad o al gab haregel, apillu olta sham meeleha shello mechamat hakkaat barzel, veken mi shebbala aluqa vehi tolaat qetanna umetzuya bammayim ukeshebbaa libsar adam motzetzet haddam ad shehi kemo chabit qetanna, ukesheadam boleah betok hammayim hu motzetzet lecha shebbemeayv venimtza kereso tzaba, veken mi shenneshako keleb shoteh o echad mizzochale apar hammemitim, apillu sapeq im memit im lav — hare hem kemakka shel chalal:

Veken mechallelin al kol makka shennaaset mechamat barzel, apillu al habbasar mibbachutz shello al gab hayyad veharegel. Veken mechallelin al shechin habba bepi hattabbaat, veal simta (vehu hanniqra plvnqr"v belaa"z), veal mi sheyyesh bo qaddachat cham beyoter, o apillu eno cham beyoter ella shehu im simur, dehaynu im qerirut (sheqqorin shvydry"n bilshon ashkenaz). Vehu shebbepaam achat ba alayv hachamimut vehaqqerirut, abal qaddachat hammatzuy shettechillato qar vesopo cham — en bo sakkana:

Mi sheachazo dam (vehu beinyan sheyyesh bo chashash sakkana) — maqqizin oto, vaapillu holek al raglayv, vaapillu hu yom harishon sheachazo haddam. (Veim en bo chashash sakkana — muttar lo lehitztannen bammayim, mippene shennireh kemeqer velo kemitkavven lirpua):

Hachoshesh beenayv, o beeno achat veyesh bah tzir, o sheshshotet mimmenna demaot mechamat hakkeeb, o sheshshotet dam, o sheyyesh bah rir shemmaglid tamid, o shehakkeeb noetz bah kemo machat, o shehu sorep veqodeach — mechallelin bitchillat hacholi shel kol ellu, mippene sheaz yesh sakkana sheim tippaqa haayin — yamut, shemmeor haayin taluy balleb. Abal besop hacholi shel kol ellu, dehaynu shekkebar hu qarob lehitrappeot velo nishar bah ella miqtzat choli sheqqodachat meat — en osin apillu al yede nokri ella dabar shehu mishshum shebut, kegon likchol besammanim hashshechuqim meetmol, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Kol choli sheharopeim omerim shehu sakkana, ap al pi shehu al habbasar mibbachutz — mechallelin alayv et hashshabbat. Veim rope echad omer tzarik chillul verope echad omer en tzarik chillul — mechallelin, shekkol sepeq nepashot lehaqel. Vaapillu en sham rope mumcheh, ella sheechad omer shehu makkir becholi zeh venireh lo shehu tzarik chillul — mechallelin al piv, ki kol beni adam chashubin mumchin qetzat, usepeq nepashot lehaqel. (Vaapillu im omer sheyyesh lehistappeq shemma hu tzarik lechillul — mechallelin. Vehu sheomer shehu makkir choli zeh). Umikkol maqom, eno neeman lehakchish et hammumcheh haomer sheen tzarik chillul, apillu im zeh omer shebbevadday tzarik chillul. Vekol zeh beyisrael, abal setam nokrim sheenan ropeim — en machaziqim otam kibqiim lechallel shabbat al pihem, kesheen sham yisrael hammakkir choli zeh:
Im lo ratza hachole[h] leqabbel hatterupa, sheeno rotzeh sheyyechallelu alayv shabbat — kopin oto, shehi chasidut shel shetut:
Choleh omer tzarik ani litrupa pelonit, verope omer en tzarik — shomein lacholeh, ki "leb yodea marat napsho". Veim harope omer sheotah hatterupa mazziq lo — shomein larope:

Choleh sheyyesh bo sakkana sheamaduhu beyom shabbat shetztzarik laasot lo repua yedua sheyyesh bah meleket chillul shabbat shemona yamim — en omerim namtin ad hallayla venimtza shello nechallel alayv ella shabbat achat, ella yaasu miyyad, ap al pi shemmechallelin alayv shette shabbatot, sheap shebbevadday lo yamut hayyom, shehare amaduhu sheyyitqayyem shemona yamim, mikkol maqom yesh lachush shemma yamut leachar hashshemona yamim im lo yatchilu laasot lo harepua miyyad. Abal bemaqom sheepshar laasot lo harepua miyyad beli chillul shabbat, ella sheyyitztareku lishhot shaa muetet — lo yechallelu kede laasotah tekep umiyyad beli shum shihuy kelal, im hu beinyan sheen chashash sakkana kelal beshihuy muat zeh, lepi shehashshabbat dechuya hi etzel piqquach nepesh velo huttera legamre, vekol sheepshar lehatztzilo belo chillul shabbat — enah nidchet bishbilo. Umikkol maqom, ap im yesh lepanenu nokrim o qetannim sheenan bene mitzvot — en omerim hare epshar laasot al yede ellu velo yitchallel shabbat al yede yisreelim bene mitzvot, lepi shemmikkevan sheen derek lehatztzilo ella baasiyyat melaka haasura beshabbat — hare nidcheh hashshabbat bishbilo legabbe yisreelim hamchuyyabim behatztzalato, veen kan chillul kelal. Velo od, ella apillu im ba hayyisrael lehachamir al atzmo laasot al yede nokri o qatan, o mechamat sheeno rotzeh litroach beatzmo — yesh issur baddabar middibre soperim, shemma yomru haroim beqoshi hittiru piqquach nepesh, veen mattirim oto lekattechilla al yede hamchuyyabim bemitzvot, veshemma yabo haddabar shekkeshello yimtzeu nokrim o qetannim — lo yirtzu lechallel al yede gedole yisrael. Vaapillu benashim shehen mechuyyabot bemitzvot veen bahen chashash zeh — ap al pi ken en moserin lahen lebaddan haeseq vehappiqquach hazzeh sheyyeaseh al yadan, ki shemma yitatztzelu o yipsheu bo. Abal mitztorpin im yisrael, umoserin haddabar leyisrael vehaishsha mitasseqet al yede hayyisrael, shekkevan shehayyisrael oseq bo — ap hi mizdarezet al yado. Umikkol maqom, mitzva min hammubchar lehishtaddel laasot hakkol al yede yisreelim gedolim bechokma, velo al yede hedyotot venashim, kede shello tehe shabbat qalla beenehem veyabou lehaqel shello bimqom piqquach nepesh, vegam kede lehorot halaka lemaaseh barabbim. Veyesh omerim shekkevan shehashshabbat dechuya hi velo huttera kelal, mah sheepshar laasot shello yehe chillul min hattora — tzarik laasot, shello yehe chillul bimlaka min hattora. Velaken im epshar laasot belo dichuy ubelo ichur al yede shinnuy — oseh al yede shinnuy, sheaz en issur min hattora. Veim epshar laasot al yede nokri belo ichur kelal — tzarik laasot al yede nokri min hattora. Velo aseru laasot al yede nokri ella bemaqom sheyyesh lachush shemma yitatztzel hannokri veyabo lide dichuy veikkub, abal lo kesheyyisrael omed alayv umezorzo beinyan sheen lachush liklum. Vehaiqqar kasbara harishona. Veap al pi ken hamminhag bimdinot ellu kasbara haacharona. Abal tob shello linhog ken, ki yesh chashash shemma yiru akshav sheen osin raq al yede nokri, yisberu sheyyesh issur bazeh leolam al yede yisrael, velipamim lo yihyeh nokri matzuy veal yede zeh yistakken hacholeh bemah sheyyamtinu al hannokri. Veal kol panim, harotzeh laasot al yede nokri — yegalleh larabbim beoto paam sheyyesh hetter leyisrael atzmo, ella shehannokri hu mezumman kan:

Kol hazzariz lechallel shabbat bedabar sheyyesh bo sakkana — hare zeh meshubbach, apillu im metaqqen immo dabar acher, kegon shepperas metzuda lehaalot tinoq shennapal lannahar vetzad immo dagim, veken kol kayyotze bazeh:
Ninala delet bipne tinoq — shober haddelet umotzio, shemma yibbaet hattinoq veyamut:

Haya choleh sheyyesh bo sakkana tzarik basar — shochatin lo, veen omerim naakilennu nebela shehi issur lav veal nechallel alayv shabbat shehi issur seqila, ki hashshabbat nittena liddachot kebar behabara ubebishshul. Veod, shebbenebalah ober al kol kezayit ukezayit. Vaapillu kesheokel pachot mikkezayit — yesh issur min hattora bekol akila vaakila, mah sheen ken bishchita eno oseh ella issur echad, ap al pi shehu chamur. Veod, shemma yihyeh hacholeh qatz baakilat issur veyiprosh veyistakken. Umikkol maqom, im hacholeh tzarik laakila lealtar vehannebela mukenet miyyad vehashshechuta mitacheret lo — maakilin oto hannebela. Abal im hu tzarik lehartiach lo yayin — yemalle yisrael veyicham nokri lepi hamminhag shennitbaer lemala. Veyashgiach alayv (ayyen beyoreh dea siman qn"g vqn"h) shello yigga bo qodem sheyyartiach, veap im yigga bo — en bekak kelum, ki ap al pi ken lo yihyeh bo ella issur middibre soperim, mah sheen ken kesheyyicham hayyisrael yaaseh issur shel tora. Veen lachush kelal sheyyaqutz hacholeh bo, lepi sheen issuro chamur kol kak:
Amaduhu haropeim shetztzarik gerogeret achat, veratzu asara vehebiu lo kol echad gerogeret — kullan peturin, veyesh lahem sakar meet Hashem, apillu hibri barishona:

Amaduhu lishte gerogerot, velo matzeu ella shette gerogerot mechubbarot kol achat beoqetz echad bipne atzmo, veod shalosh gerogerot mechubbarot sheloshtan beoqetz echad — koret haoqetz sheyyesh bo shalosh, sheap shemmarbeh bigrogerot, mikkol maqom memaet bitlisha shehi iqqar hammelaka. Abal im hayu shettayim beoqetz echad veshalosh beoqetz echad — lo yikretu ella haoqetz sheyyesh bo shettayim, sheasur leharbot beshiur haddabar shehammelaka naaset bo, ap al pi sheeno marbeh betorach hammelaka, shehakkol naaset bebat achat. Umikkol maqom, im haddabar bahul — en medaqdeqim bekak, shello yabo lide dichuy veikkub:

Choleh shennapal mechamat cholyo lemishkab veen bo sakkana, o sheyyesh lo michush shemmitztaer kol kak ad shennechelash mimmennu kol gupo, sheaz ap al pi sheholek kenapal lemishkab hu domeh — hare tzerakayv naasin al yede nokri, apillu bimlakot gemurot shel tora, kegon leepot lo o lebashshel lo im tzarik lekak. Veap al pi shekkol maakalot haasurot apillu middibre soperim lo hittiru otan lecholeh sheen bo sakkana — ap al pi ken hittiru lo issur bishshule nokrim beshabbat, shei epshar beinyan acher, kevan shehu muttar mechamat atzmo ella shemmaaseh hannokri gorem lo haissur. Abal en mechallelin alayv shabbat al yede yisrael beissur shel tora, apillu yesh bo sakkanat eber, kol sheen bo sakkanat nepesh. Ulechallel alayv yisrael beissure dibre soperim beyadayim, kegon laasot lo kol repua, shehi asura mishshum gezerat shechiqat sammanim ap al pi sheen bah beatzmah shum serak melaka baasiyyatah apillu middibre soperim, o apillu yesh gam bah beatzmah issur middibre soperim baasiyyatah — muttar laasotah lo belo shum shinnuy midderek hachol, im yesh bo sakkanat eber, ap al pi shello napal lemishkab vegam lo chala mimmennu kol gupo. Abal im en bo sakkanat eber, ella shennapal lemishkab, o shemmitztaer kol kak ad shechala mimmennu kol gupo — en osin lo dabar haasur middibre soperim al yede yisrael ella beshinnuy midderek hachol. Veal yede shinnuy muttar laasot apillu melaka gemura, kegon haggoneach [shemmuttar linaq] bepiv, kemo sheyyitbaer, shekkevan shemmeshanneh baasiyyatah — enah asura ella middibre soperim. Veim tzarik lo leekol maakalim hannikkarim shehem lirpua, ap al pi sheyyesh bazeh issur middibre soperim mishshum gezerat shechiqat sammanim, kemo sheyyitbaer, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu (dabar shei epshar leolam laasoto al yede nokri vehu) choleh bekol gupo — hittiru lo. Veyesh oserin. Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel:

Veim lo napal lemishkab, vegam eno mitztaer kol kak ad shennechelash kol gupo (abal al kol panim yesh lo tzaar gadol) — muttar laasot lo al yede yisrael kol shebut hannaaseh beshinnuy, apillu hu melaka. Abal asur lo leekol maakalim hannikkarim shehem lirpua, vekol shekken shear shebutim shello beshinnuy, ap al pi sheen bahem serak melaka. Veken laasot melaka gemura al yede nokri, shezzehu shebut gamur, shello beshinnuy. Veim en lo tzaar gadol velo choli hakkolel kol haggup, ella miqtzat choli — azay muttar lo laasot kol shebut middibre soperim al yede nokri apillu shello beshinnuy, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"z, abal lo al yede yisrael apillu beshinnuy. Velaken muttar laasot lo repua mibbachutz al yede nokri sheyyannichenna sham alayv, kevan shehu eno oseh maaseh bazeh. Veap shemmesayyea lo qetzat — en bekak kelum, kemo shennitbaer lemala (abal asur leekol maakalim hannikkarim shehem lirpua al derek sheyyitbaer). Abal im en lo apillu miqtzat choli, ella michush bealma — asur laasot lo apillu al yede nokri shum dabar hannikkar shehu lirpua, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Kol sheasur laasot al yede yisrael — asur apillu al yede hacholeh beatzmo. Abal kesheoseh lo hannokri — muttar lacholeh lesayyeo qetzat, kegon nokri hakkochel leen yisrael besop hacholi shehi qodachat meat — muttar lo liptoach velisgor haayin sheyyikkanes bah hakkechol yapeh, shemmesayyea en bo mammash, kol shehaya yakol hannokri laasoto bilbaddo belo siyyua hayyisrael ella shello haya hayyisrael meakkeb al yado, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vaapillu keshehannokri oseh lo melaka gemura bemaqom shemmuttar — muttar lacholeh lesayyeo beinyan zeh shennitbaer. (Veap al pi shehamsayyea limlaka gemura hu shebut gamur middibre soperim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shm"v, veap keshemmesayyea lishbut al kol panim hu shebut dishbut, mikkol maqom kan kevan shehittiru shebut amira lenokri letzorek hacholeh — hu haddin sheyyesh lehattir shebut hassiyyua, kevan sheyyesh bo gam ken tzorek hacholeh, sheal yede kak naaset harepua yoter betob mimmah shehayeta naaset al yede hannokri lebaddo, kegon segirat haayin sheyyikkanes bo hakkechol yapeh, veken petichat haayin lehaknis bo hakkechol, o liptichat happeh lehotzi hashshen, ap shehaya hannokri yakol laasotah bilbaddo, mikkol maqom lo hitzriku chakamim lekak lehatil zeh al hannokri veshello yaasehu mi shehaddabar shayyak lo laasoto, dehaynu hacholeh beatzmo. Abal keshehannokri oseh shear dabar haasur, apillu middibre soperim — en leyisrael (acher) lesayyeo baasiyyato, kevan sheen tzorek kelal besiyyuo, shehare hannokri yakol laasoto bilbaddo. Abal im yesh ezeh tzorek besiyyuo, sheal yede kak naaset harepua yoter betob mimmah shehaya oseh hannokri bilbaddo — muttar ap leyisrael acher lesayyeo qetzat). Veim i epshar leheasot kelal bilti siyyua hayyisrael — asur ap lacholeh atzmo lesayyeo:
Muttar lomar lenokri laasot tabshil leqatan sheen lo mah leekol, shessetam tzorke qatan dinam ketzorke choleh sheen bo sakkana. Umuttar lehaakilo muqtzeh apillu beyadayim, im i epshar beinyan acher:
Lo hittiru amira lenokri bishbil choleh ella keshetztzarik lah beshabbat, abal lo letzorek motzae shabbat:

Hiqqiz dam venitztannen — sakkana hi, veosin lo medura beshabbat apillu bitqupat tammuz. Abal lecholeh acher, ap al pi sheyyesh bo sakkana, mikkol maqom en betzinna sakkana lo, sheepshar lechammemo bibgadim, laken en osin lo medura ella al yede nokrim, ella im ken en sham begadim lechammemo bahem. Ulehaomerim shekkol choleh sheyyesh bo sakkana osin lo al yede yisrael kol mah shergilin laasot lo bechol, ap al pi sheen bimniat haddabar hahu sakkana — (mikkol maqom) muttar laasot lo gam ken medura al yede yisrael kedarko bechol (ukebar nitbaer lemala heak yesh linhog bimdinot ellu):

En notenin yayin letok haayin, mippene shennikkar haddabar shemmitkavven lirpua. Abal muttar litteno al gabbe haayin, mippene sheeno nireh ella kerochetz velo kemitkavven lirpua. Vehu sheeno poteach vesoger haayin, abal im potechah vesogerah sheyyikkanes bah hayyayin — nikkar haddabar shemmitkavven lirpua veasur. Veakshav sheen derek lirchotz beyayin — asur bekol inyan keshemmitkavven lirpua:

Roq tapel, dehaynu kol shello taam kelum mishshenneor mishshenato, vehu chazaq umerappe — asur litteno apillu al gabbe haayin, sheeno nireh kerochetz, sheen derek lirchotz beroq mippene meisuto. Abal im rochetz piv bemayim veachar kak maabiram al enayv, ap al pi sheroq tapel meorab bahem — muttar, mippene sheenan meusin lirchotz bahem. Veim eno yakol liptoach enayv — muttar lelachlecham apillu beroq tapel lebaddo, shello aseru ella bemitkavven lirpua, abal zo enah repua:

Shoreh adam qilorin rakkin utzelulin meereb shabbat venoten al gabbe haayin beshabbat lirpua, veen gozerim mishshum shechiqat sammanim, shekkevan shehitzrikuhu lishrotan meereb shabbat — yesh lo hekker bazeh sheasur laasoq birpuot beshabbat. Veen lachush lemarit haayin, mippene sheeno nireh ella kerochetz, shekkevan shehu rak vetzalul — sabur haroeh shehu yayin. Ubilbad shello yiptach veyisgor haayin, sheaz mukach shemmitkavven lirpua. Abal qilor ab — asur litteno al gabbe ayin beshabbat, mippene shennikkar shehu lirpua. Veim hinnicho aleha mibbeod yom — muttar, kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"b:

Maabirin gelde makka vesakin bashshemen, bimqomot sheddarkan lasuk ap shello lirpua, kemo shennitbaer besiman shk"z. Abal lo yasuk bacheleb, mippene shennimmoach, veasur mittaam shennitbaer besiman shk"v. Vaapillu bigmar makka, dehaynu shekkebar nitrappea veen lo tzaar mimmenna — muttar lehaabir gildeha ulesukah letaanug bealma. Abal en notenin shemen vechammin meorabim yachad al gabbe makka, velo al gabbe mok litteno aleha, mippene shennikkar shemmitkavven lirpua. Abal notenan al besaro chutz lemakka, sheaz eno mukach shemmitkavven lirpua, vehem shotetim veyoredim lammakka. Abal muttar latet aleha shemen lebaddo bimqomot sheddarkan lasuk shello lirpua. Veken muttar latet aleha chammin lebaddan, im huchammu meereb shabbat, veken (muttar litten shemen lebaddo) al gabbe mok litteno aleha. (Abal lo chammin apillu lebaddan (im en hammok (ayyen siman sh"a) meyuchad lekak), mishshum gezera shemma yischot. Abal bashshemen en gozerim shemma yischot, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"k):

Muttar litten al gabbe hammakka sepog vachatikot begadim yebeshim im hem chadashim, mippene sheenan lirpua, ella kede shello yesaretu begadayv et hammakka. Abal lo chatikot begadim yeshanim, shehen merappeot. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello hayu meolam al hammakka, abal im hayu kebar al hammakka — shub enan merappeot ap al pi shehen yeshanot, umuttar litteno al gabbe makka beshabbat:

Notenin aleh al gabbe hammakka beshabbat, sheeno ella kimshammerah, chutz meale gepanim shehem lirpua, vehu haddin kol alin shehen merappein. Veim netanam aleha mibbeod yom vehesiram mealeha mishshechasheka apillu bemezid — muttar lehachazirah, mippene shello aseru kol repua mishshum gezerat shechiqat sammanim ella keshemmatchilah beshabbat, abal lo keshekkebar asaah lo mibbeod yom umachazirah lo beshabbat. Abal retiyya shehesirah meal gabbe hammakka bemezid, apillu odah beyado — asur lehachazirah, gezera shemma yemareach veyachaliq haggumot shebbah veyitchayyeb mishshum memacheq, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"d. Abal im huchleqa meal gabbe hammakka meeleha mishshechasheka — lo gazeru bazeh, umuttar lehachazirah. Vaapillu im nopla mimmennu legamre — dinah kehuchleqa. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennopla al gabbe keli, abal im nopla al gabbe qarqa, im ba lehachazirah — hare zeh kemannicha battechilla beshabbat, veasur, gezera shemma yemareach umishshum gezerat shechiqat sammanim. Veal yede nokri muttar lehannichah al hammakka apillu battechilla, im yesh lo mimmenna tzaar umiqtzat choli, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal asur lomar lenokri laasot haretiyya beshabbat, shemmeruach haretiyya hu melaka gemura, veal yede nokri hu shebut gamur, velo hittiruhu ella im ken chala kol gupo o sheyyesh sakkanat eber, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Megalleh adam qetzat retiyya umeqanneach pi hammakka umachazirah aleha, vechozer umegalleh qetzatah hashsheni umeqanneach pi hammakka umachazirah aleha, shekkevan sheeno mesirah kullah bebat achat — muttar lehachazirah. Abal lo yeqanneach et haretiyya, mippene shehu memareach:

Makka shennitrappea — muttar litten aleha retiyya battechilla beshabbat, mippene sheeno ella kimshammerah shello yesortuha begadayv. Veen lachush shemma yemareach o yishchoq sammanim, shekkevan shekkebar nitrappea — eno bahul aleha kol kak sheyyabo lide meruach ushechiqat sammanim:

Hammepis mursa beshabbat, im kede laasot lah peh bishbil sheyyikkanes bah haavir lirpua — hare zeh chayyab mishshum "makkeh bappattish", mippene shehu metaqqen lah petach, vekol hamtaqqen petach leshum dabar talush — chayyab mishshum tiqqun keli shehu toledet "makkeh bappattish", kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"[d], umah li tiqqun keli umah li tiqqun makka, laken gam betiqqun petach lemakka yesh bo mishshum "makkeh bappattish". Veap al pi sheen chayyabin ella al petach heasuy lehaknis ulehotzi, kemo shennitbaer sham — hare ap petach zeh asuy lehaknis avir ulehotzi lecha tamid. Veim hepisah kede lehotzi mimmenna hallecha hamtzaarto bilbad, velo kede lehaknis bo avir lirpua — muttar. Veap al pi shemmimmela naaseh petach harauy lehaknis ulehotzi, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno tzarik lekak — hare zo melaka sheenah tzerika legupah. Veap lehaomerim shemmelaka sheenah tzerika legupah chayyab aleha, mikkol maqom kan kevan shechiyyubo hu mishshum tiqqun hammakka, im ken kesheeno tzarik letiqqun zeh veeno mitkavven lo, ap shennaaseh meelayv — en zeh chashub tiqqun kelal, vahare zeh keillu lo asa velo kelum, ella sheyyesh ligzor shemma yitkavven lepetach, umishshum tzaaro lo gazeru. Veyesh mi sheomer shello hittiru ella keshemmepisah letzorek hallecha shel akshav bilbad, veeno choshesh im tachazor vetistom. Abal im chapetz shettishshaer kak petucha lehotzi lecha tamid, ap al pi sheeno mitkavven lehaknis lah avir — asur. Vetob lachush lidbarayv laasot al yede nokri:

Abal asur lachuk shechin, shemmotzi dam, veyesh bo mishshum chobel. Veeno domeh lehotzaat lecha, shehallecha enah mechubberet umublaat babbasar ella kemupqedet unetuna betok keli, ukeshemmepis hashshechin lehotziah — eno ella kepoteach keli lehotzi mah shebbetoko, mah sheen ken bedam, shehu mechubbar umubla babbasar:

Neqeb shebbammakka shekkebar niptach uba leharchibo beshabbat, apillu kol shehu — asur. Abal im chazar venistam — yesh lehistappeq im muttar lachazor ulepotcho beshabbat kebattechilla, kemo shemmuttar liptoach neqeb shennistam bikli, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"d. Veken otam sheyyesh lahem neqeb bazzeroa sheqqorin aptura"a venistam hanneqeb qetzat — yesh lehistappeq im muttar litten betoko qitnit sheyyippatach. Uretiyya muttar litten al haaptura"a, shehare hi kemakka shennitrappea shemmuttar litten aleha retiyya kemo shennitbaer (besiman zeh). Veyesh mi sheoser litten al haaptura"a (veyesh lachush lidbarayv). Veim yodea shemmotzi dam keshemmeqannechah — lo yeqanchah beshabbat, di"pesiq resheh" hu. Abal muttar lehachalip beged acher, sheim lo yachalip yasriach, vegadol kebod habberiyyot, vegam yesh lo tzaar mizzeh. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemakka zo sheyyesh bah neqeb, abal bemakka sheen bah neqeb — asur lehachalip habbeged o hanneyar, (lepi) shemmoshek lecha mehammakka (bintilato otam mealeha), veasur mishshum mepareq, kemo sheyyitbaer. Vekol shekken shello yanniach tzvq"r zl"b al hammakka sheen bah neqeb:

Mi shenniggepa yado o raglo shello mechamat barzel — tzometah beyayin kede lehaamid haddam, abal lo bechometz, mippene shehu chazaq, veyesh bo mishshum repua. Veim hu meunnag — ap hayyayin moil lo kemo hachometz, veasur kesheen hammakka al gab hayyad o al gab haregel, sheaz muttar lechallel aleha apillu bimlaka gemura, veken im hi mechamat hakkaat barzel, kemo shennitbaer lemala:
Mi shennishmat pereq yado o raglo, dehaynu sheyyatza haetzem mimmeqomo — lo yeshapshepennu harbeh betzonen, shezzehu repuato, ella rochetz kedarko, veim nitrappe — nitrappe:

Tzipporen shepperesha, vetzitzin shehem kemin retzuot daqqot sheppereshu meor haetzba sebib hatztzipporen, im pereshu rubban, kevan shehem qerobim lehinnateq — en bahem mishshum gozez min hattora, apillu keshechotekan bikli, ella sheasur middibre soperim. Abal lehasir beyad, sheen zo derek geziza — muttar apillu lekattechilla, im hen metzaarot oto. Vehu sheppereshu kelappe mala, dehaynu shehitchilu liprosh [le]tzad hatztzipporen. Veyesh omerim she"kelappe mala" hu kelappe haggup, velo kelappe hatztzipporen. Vetzarik lachush lishne happerushim. Veim lo pereshu rubban unetalan beyad — patur, abal asur. Chatakan bikli — chayyab mishshum gozez, veap lehaomerim shemmelaka sheenah tzerika legupah patur — (v)yesh omerim shebbegozez chayyab ledibre hakkol, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman sh"m:

Hachoshesh beshinnayv — lo yegammea bahen chometz veyiplot, shennikkar hu shehu lirpua, abal megammea ubolea, o metabbel bo pitto veyoklennu kedarko bechol. Vaapillu al yede nokri asur laasot lo shum dabar, ap al pi sheen beoto dabar shum serak melaka apillu middibre soperim, ella shennikkar shehi lirpua. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemichush bealma, abal im yesh lo tzaar kol kak ad shennechlash kol gupo mimmennu — muttar laasot al yede nokri kol dabar sheen issuro ella middibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Hachoshesh bigrono — lo yeareennu bashshemen, dehaynu lehashhot shemen bepiv terem sheyyiblaennu, shennikkar shemmekavven lirpua, abal bolea hu shemen, veim nitrappe — nitrappe. Veyesh oserim apillu libloa, mippene shehashshemen hu mazziq laggup, veen derek lishtoto ella lirpua. Vehakkol lepi hammaqom vehazzeman, sheim en derek beriim libloa — asur. Abal muttar litten shemen harbeh letok anigeron velibloa, sheaz eno mazziq laggup, veeno nikkar shemmitkavven lirpua ella lishtiyya. Ubilbad sheyyiblaennu miyyad velo yashhennu bepiv, veen tzarik lomar shello yipletennu, sheaz nikkar shemmitkavven lirpua:

Haggoneach mikkeeb leb, sherpuato linaq bepiv min habbehema — muttar linaq beshabbat, mippene shemmepareq kilachar yad hu, sheen derek linaq bepiv ella lachalob letok keli velishtot mimmennu, lepikak en biniqa issur min hattora ella middibre soperim, umishshum tzaaro lo gozrav. Bammeh debarim amurim? Betzaar shel haggoneach, abal im en lo ella tzaar shel raab — asur linaq mehabbehema beshabbat, abal beyom tob muttar linaq (im i epshar lo lachalob al yede nokri, vegam en lo maakal lachalob letoko):

Lo taqqil ishsha chalab middaddeha letok hakkos o letok haqqedera lehaniq et benah, mippene shehacholeb letok keli mepareq gamur hu, vechayyab mishshum dash, velo hittiru melaka gemura ella bimqom sakkana. Abal muttar leishsha leqalleach mehechalab bikde sheyyeechoz hattinoq et haddad veyinoq, shekkevan shehechalab hazzeh holek leibbud — en bo mishshum mepareq min hattora ella middibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"k, uletzorek hattinoq lo gazeru. Abal asur lehattiz mechalabah al mi shennashap bo ruach raa, mippene sheen bo sakkana vegam lo tzaar gadol kede shennattir lo issur middibre soperim al yede yisrael kemo shehittiru begoneach vedomayv, ayyen sop siman sh"l:
En loasin min serap hanniqra matzteki, velo shapin et hashshinnayim besam. Ematay? Bizman shemmitkavven lirpua, abal im eno mitkavven ella mishshum reach happeh — muttar:

Kol okalin umashqin shehem maakal beriim — muttar leoklan velishtotan lirpua, ap al pi shehem qashim liqtzat debarim venikkar qetzat shemmitkavven lirpua, kegon techol sheqqasheh libne meayim ella sheyyapeh umoil leshinnayim, o karshinin sheqqashin leshinnayim ella sheyyapin umerappein libne meayim, ap al pi ken kevan shedderek habberiim leoklan lipamim gam shello lirpua — muttar leoklan gam lirpua. Vekol sheeno maakal umashqeh beriim — asur leoklo velishtoto lirpua, gezera mishshum shechiqat sammanim. Vehu sheyyesh lo michush bealma umitchazzeq veholek kebari, ap al pi shekkoeb lo meod. Abal im chala mimmennu kol gupo, ap al pi shemmitchazzeq veholek, veen tzarik lomar im napal lemishkab — kebar nitbaer lemala sheyyesh mattirin. Abal im en lo michush kelal, veeno mitkavven kelal lirpua ella letzorek acher, kegon haokel serapim metuqim vegomea betza chayya kede lehanim haqqol — muttar. Abal keshemmitkavven lirpua — asur, ap al pi shehu bari gamur veen lo shum michush:

En osim appiqetvizin, dehaynu geramat qi, shello letzorek repua, apillu bechol, mishshum hepsed okalin shebbemeayv, shemmittok kak hu raeb vechozer veokel. Veim mitztaer merob hammaakal — bechol muttar apillu besam, ubeshabbat asur besam, mippene sheddomeh lirpua, abal muttar lehaknis yado letok gerono ad sheyyaqi:

Hachoshesh bemeayv — muttar likpot alehem kos sheeru mimmennu chammin, ap al pi sheadayin yesh bo hebel. Veken muttar lehaalot oznayim, dehaynu gide haozen sheyyoredin lipamim umitporqin hallechayayim — maalin otam ben beyad ben bikli. Veken lehaalot unqeli, dehaynu tenuk shekkeneged halleb shennikpap letzad penim. Mippene shekkol echad meellu en osin oto besamemanim kede shennachush lishchiqa, veyesh lo tzaar mehem:

Veken mi shennishtakker, sherpuato lasuk kappot yadayv veraglayv beshemen umelach — muttar lesukam beshabbat mittaam zeh. Veen lilmod mizzeh hetter leotam shennohagim biqtzat medinot lehasim tok hachotem eper meeseb katush lehapig hashshikrut, ki oto eper peullato kirpua lishar debarim gam ken, veshayyak bo gezerat shechiqat sammanim:

Asur leshapshep al haggup bekoach, apillu letaanug bealma, kemo shennitbaer besiman shk"z, veen tzarik lomar kede sheyyiga veyazzia. Veken asur leyaggea atzmo bishar dabar kede sheyyazzia lirpua, gezera shemma yishchaq veyishteh sammanim hammebiim zea. Veasur lidchoq kereso shel tinoq kede lehotzi harei, shemma yabo lehashqoto sammanim hamshalshelim:

Rochatzin lirpua beme gerar ubeme chamtan ubeme teberya ubammayim hayyapim shebbayyam haggadol, ap al pi shehem meluchim, lepi shekken derek lirchotz bahem ap shello lirpua, veeno nikkar shemmekavven lirpua. Abal lo bammayim haraim shebbayyam haggadol, velo beme mishreh, shehem meusim, veen derek lirchotz bahem shello lirpua. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheshshoheh bahem, abal im eno shoheh — muttar, sheeno nireh ella kemeqer. Ubemaqom sheen derek lirchotz bechamme teberya ella lirpua — asur lirchotz bahem beshabbat lirpua, apillu eno shoheh bahem:

En rochatzin bemayim hamshalshelim, velo betit shettobein bo. Veen shotin mashqeh hamshalshel, apillu hu maakal beriim veeno shotehu lirpua kelal. Mippene shekkol ellu tzaar hem, vekatub: "veqarata lashshabbat oneg":
Lochashin al nechashim veaqrabbim bishbil shello yazziqu, ap al pi sheenan ratzin acharayv, veen bekak mishshum tzeda, apillu lehamchayyebim bimlaka sheenah tzerika legupah:
Notenin keli al gabbe haayin lehaqer, vehu sheyyehe keli hammuttar betiltul. Vehu haddin mah sheosin leadam shechash beenayv, shemmaqqipin oto betabbaat kede shello yitpashshet hannepach:

Etzem sheyyatza mimmeqomo — asur lehachaziro, mippene sheddomeh leboneh (veod shekkol repua asura). Vaapillu leshapshepo harbeh betzonen — asur, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal etzem shennishbar — machazirim oto limqomo, sheim lo yachaziruhu beshabbat — yesh bazeh sakkana leoto eber, ubimqom sakkanat eber lo gazeru:

Asur lehanniach beged al makka sheyyotze mimmenna dam, mippene shehaddam yitzba oto. Veap al pi shemmeqalqel hu, mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim. Vekol shekken bebeged adom, shemmetaqqeno. Vei epshar lo lehotzi techilla et haddam mehammakka, mishshum chobel, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Ella ketzad yaaseh? Korek aleha qure akkabish umekasseh bahem kol haddam vekol hachabbura, veachar kak korek aleha semartut. Veyesh mepaqpeqim leesor kerikat qure akkabish, mippene shemmerappeim, ella yirchotz bammayim o bayyayin techilla lehaabir haddam shebbammakka, veachar kak yikrok aleha hassemartut. Vetob lachush ledibrehem, abal haiqqar kasbara harishona:

Asur limtzotz bepiv dam mehammakka, mishshum chobel. Ubammila lo hittiru ella mippene hassakkana. Velaken asur limtzotz dam shebben hashshinnayim (veap al pi shehu mepareq kilachar yad, mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim), veasur lehanniach al hammakka dabar hammoshek dam velecha, mishshum mepareq. Veap al pi shemmoshek meatzmo, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu mannicho sham kede limshok — hare zeh kechobel umepareq beyadayv:

Asur lasum petila bepi hattabbaat kederek shennohagim laasot lemi shehu atzur, ella im ken yasim otah beshinnuy, sheyyochazenna bishte etzbeotayv veyannichenna benachat, mishshum hashsharat nimin, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"b. Abal asur laasot qrysty"r apilu al yede shinnuy, apillu hekinah meetmol (mishshum gezerat shechiqat sammanim), im lo becholeh. Vegam becholeh tzarik lizzaher shello yabo lide melaka gemura shel tora, (veken) im epshar laasot al yede nokri — yaaseh al yede nokri:
